answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in text generation, proving particularly effective for question-answering (QA) tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates either answers to unambiguous queries or clarification requests for ambiguous queries.

answer_2.quote: For unambiguous queries, we measure the quality of the generation by employing RougeL with all the possible valid answers. The prediction from the model is regarded as correct if the score is above 0.3.
